static_traits.name: Jameson
static_traits.family_status: Mother is a Teacher; other Not mentioned
static_traits.social_status: Good relationships with friends, Has several close friends who can provide support, but difficulties in romantic relationships
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychotherapy history; not yet had similar problem history
static_traits.language_features: High cooperativeness, Positive attitude; clear and logical expression; able to describe Loneliness and Self-doubt; but difficulty discussing dating dilemmas with friends

basic_info.main_problem: Has been unable to find a dating partner for the past two years, believing the reason is only liking outdoor picnics and being close to nature; this belief leads to persistent Loneliness and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent Loneliness and Self-doubt significantly affect mental health and overall well-being, hence seeking counseling.
growth_experiences: Began actively seeking a romantic partner two years ago, experiencing repeated rejection and lack of interest; stress was initially moderate, then frequently felt Loneliness and Self-doubt when seeing others in love or hearing dating success stories.

During the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, social interaction and dating opportunities were restricted, further reducing offline contact and the possibility of meeting partners, aggravating the persistence of the problem.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being liked / being loved

special_situations.event: Seeing others in romantic relationships or hearing dating success stories
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have no partner, it means I am not worthy of being loved or something is wrong with me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increasing dating-seeking efforts (online dating, Attending social activities, asking friends for introductions)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one will want to date me

special_situations.event: Encounters rejection or lack of interest from the other party in dating attempts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Being rejected once means I am essentially unpopular
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increased self-doubt, less proactive expression and discussion with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Something is wrong with me, so Being rejected is inevitable

special_situations.event: The pandemic reduced social and dating opportunities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Fewer social opportunities equals being doomed to not find a partner
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Mainly relies on online methods to try; offline participation is limited
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: In this environment I will surely not find a partner

special_situations.event: Interacting with others or thinking of others' views of one's interests
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others will judge me for my interests and look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding expressing romantic intentions to friends, reducing exploration of building deeper connections with people of the same interests
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They find my interests strange and will not want to date me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to build intimate relationships, to be accepted and liked
core_conflict.fear: Fear of Being rejected and being judged abnormal / unworthy
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of Being rejected through cautious Self-protection and less exposure of vulnerability
Attributing failure to personal defects to maintain a controllable Interpretation (though at the cost of Self-denial)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to talk to friends or others about dating difficulties
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: He believes the other will look down on him like a judge (transference: seeing others as negating him)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a cautious tone, avoid deep disclosure, use vague and general expressions, Displacing topics when necessary.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Encountering rejection or cold responses after dating attempts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The other's rejection equals having defects oneself; no one will like oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use self-blaming language to describe experiences, emphasizing one's own inadequacy, in a low tone.

manifestations: Unable to find a date for two years
Sense of Loneliness markedly worsens when seeing others in love or hearing dating success stories
Unwilling to discuss dating and Loneliness dilemmas with friends

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the energy their original desire would send outward, gives up seeking help from others outwardly, and instead acts on themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not proactively seeking help from friends when facing dating dilemmas
Chooses to 'endure', reduces expressing real feelings and needs

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Assuming others will judge and look down on oneself because of one's interests
Presuming in interactions that others are unwilling to date oneself

positive_force: Has several close friends who can provide support
Positive attitude, willing to try and open to accepting suggestions
Has tried online dating, Attending social activities, asking friends for introductions — showing initiative
There are friends nearby who also like outdoor activities (potential resource)
negative_force: Cognitive biases like overgeneralization, mind-reading, and personalization maintain Self-doubt
The pandemic limiting social and dating opportunities
Hard to discuss difficulties with friends, reduces seeking support
Comparing with others produces despair, leading to Insufficient motivation

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Self-doubt in dating-related situations, avoiding expressing romantic interest
antecedent: Seeing others in romantic relationships or hearing dating success stories
Encountering rejection or the other party's indifference in dating attempts
Thinking that others may judge oneself because of one's interests
The pandemic reducing offline social opportunities
target_behavior.core_reason: Stemming from the core belief 'I am not worthy of being loved / I have problems', maintained and reinforced by cognitive biases like overgeneralization and mind-reading
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the emotional pain of Being rejected and shame, maintaining surface safety
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty building romantic relationships, Loneliness and Self-doubt worsen, daily motivation and Decreased interest, Decreased sense of happiness
